set.signal: RECORD Q2 AND A STEP-CHANGE GUIDE: revenue $392.4M, up 27% sequentially and 104% year over year, on 'diversified growth across AI FABRICS and SIGNAL CONDITIONING'. Q3 2026 guided to $540-560 MILLION, with ~72% gross margin (GAAP and non-GAAP), non-GAAP opex $156-160M and non-GAAP EPS $1.16-1.21; the inflection is explicitly 'driven by SCORPIO X-SERIES 320-LANE FABRIC SWITCH PRODUCTION RAMP'. Ecosystem: at Computex 2026 gave the first public demonstration of the Scorpio X-Series 320-lane Smart Fabric Switch plus ultra-low-latency optical connectivity, NVIDIA MGX-BASED REFERENCE DESIGNS, 200G/lane SerDes and COSMOS rack-level validation; expanded Taiwan operations and Cloud-Scale Interop Lab for closer coordination with AMD, Arm, Intel and NVIDIA.
set.figure: Record $392.4M (+104% YoY); Q3 guide $540-560M on Scorpio X ramp; GM ~72%

items.evidence: We delivered net income of $531 million and earnings per share of $3.7.

set.signal: Q3 FY2026 (quarter ended 07-31-2026) record results, above the high end of guidance on both revenue and EPS. Orders $2.091B, +56% reported (+52% core; acquisitions +5pp, FX -1pp) - the SECOND consecutive quarter above $2B. Revenue $1.846B, +36% reported (+31% core). Gross margin 69%; opex $661M; operating margin 33.2%, +820bps YoY and ABOVE the 31-32% long-term target; core operating margin 34.7% on a 66% incremental. Non-GAAP net income $531M; EPS grew 79% (the transcript renders the EPS amount as '$3.7'; the filed per-share figures are on the Keysight 8-K (08-18-2026) entry). Segments: CSG revenue $1.345B +43% reported (+36% core), GM 70.8%, OM 34%; within CSG commercial communications delivered its FIRST $1B QUARTER at $1.006B, +56%, and WIRELINE REVENUE EXCEEDED WIRELESS FOR THE FIRST TIME (also true year-to-date). Aerospace/defense/government $339M, +14%. EISG record $501M, +21%, GM 64.1%, OM 31%, with double-digit order growth in all three markets. Software and services ~33% of revenue (record in dollars, both growing double digits), ARR 24% of mix. Cash $2.605B; operating cash flow $437M; free cash flow $403M; ~640k shares repurchased at ~$326 average for $210M ($517M YTD). Gross margin described as sustainable in the 'upper 60s percent'.
set.figure: Orders $2.091B (+56%), rev $1.846B (+36%), NG net income $531M, EPS +79%, OM 33.2%
